trap.label: pontuação de conectores
trap.wrong: It was late, nevertheless we left.
trap.right: It was late; nevertheless, we left.
trap.why: O português aceita vírgula antes de "no entanto". Em inglês, conector entre orações exige ponto-e-vírgula ou ponto.

fix.wrong: The fee is high, therefore we help.
fix.right: The fee is high; therefore, we help.

rewrite.prompt: Una com nevertheless: “It was hard. They finished.”
rewrite.answer: It was hard; nevertheless, they finished.

rewrite.prompt: Una com therefore: “Prices rose. Demand fell.”
Reescreva com furthermore: “It is cheap. It is fast. (add)”
rewrite.answer: It is cheap; furthermore, it is fast.
